articles.title: Billing: failed upgrades and duplicate authorizations
articles.excerpt: If an upgrade is unsuccessful and the user reports multiple charges, do not promise a refund or assume the charges have settled. Verify transaction state through billing systems and refer to Billing Support for review. Pending authorizations and captured charges are not the same.

articles.title: Service access: HTTP 500 troubleshooting
articles.excerpt: HTTP 500 indicates a server-side error. When multiple organization members report it, promptly escalate to the incident team. A global status page being green is not conclusive for an account-specific or regional incident. Regional diagnosis must be confirmed by infrastructure monitoring.

articles.title: Appearance settings and dark mode diagnostics
articles.excerpt: Users can inspect Settings > Appearance. If the app does not follow System Default, record app version, operating system, and reproduction steps, then refer to Product Support. Availability of a separate Dark toggle and scheduled auto-switch is NOT confirmed by this knowledge base; do not claim those features exist.
